Class ContextLifecycleScheduledTaskRegistrar

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.scheduling.config.ScheduledTaskRegistrar
org.springframework.scheduling.config.ContextLifecycleScheduledTaskRegistrar
All Implemented Interfaces:
DisposableBean, InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton, ScheduledTaskHolder
public class ContextLifecycleScheduledTaskRegistrar extends ScheduledTaskRegistrar implements SmartInitializingSingleton
ScheduledTaskRegistrar 子类，将任务的实际调度重定向到 afterSingletonsInstantiated() 回调（自 4.1.2 起）。
Since:
3.2.1
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中
